# Preliminary Species Idenfitified for Assessment in 2027 

The available data collected from select scientific surveys are provided to inform final selection of species to assess in 2027.

```{r loop-2027-species, results="asis", dpi = 36}

#this will be updated for 2027 species
species_for_2027 <- c(
  "chilipepper"
  )

data |>
  filter(Common_name %in% species_for_2027) |>
  arrange(Common_name, .locale = "en") |>
	group_by(Common_name) |>
	distinct(Common_name) |>
	pull(Common_name) |>
	as.character() |>
	walk(multiplot)
 
```


# Other Groundfish Species


```{r loop-output, results="asis", dpi = 36}

test <- c(
  "petrale sole"
  )

data |>
  filter(Common_name %in% c(test)) |>
#  filter(!Common_name %in% c(species_for_2027)) |>
  arrange(Common_name, .locale = "en") |>
	group_by(Common_name) |>
	distinct(Common_name) |>
	pull(Common_name) |>
	as.character() |>
	walk(multiplot_brief)
 
```
